problem_text:
An international courier network must coordinate a sequence of twelve critical package handoffs between major regional hubs.

The transit durations between hubs, measured in minutes, are precisely known:
* Hub α to β: 98.3 minutes
* α to γ: 125.2 minutes
* α to δ: 62.0 minutes
* α to ε: 99.0 minutes
* α to ζ: 87.7 minutes
* α to η: 28.3 minutes
* α to θ: 106.7 minutes
* α to ι: 202.2 minutes
* α to κ: 82.7 minutes
* α to λ: 118.9 minutes
* α to μ: 120.1 minutes
* β to γ: 155.3 minutes
* β to δ: 38.1 minutes
* β to ε: 101.6 minutes
* β to ζ: 21.2 minutes
* β to η: 77.1 minutes
* β to θ: 151.1 minutes
* β to ι: 199.6 minutes
* β to κ: 89.5 minutes
* β to λ: 20.6 minutes
* β to μ: 70.8 minutes
* γ to δ: 145.0 minutes
* γ to ε: 55.1 minutes
* γ to ζ: 134.1 minutes
* γ to η: 109.9 minutes
* γ to θ: 24.2 minutes
* γ to ι: 84.7 minutes
* γ to κ: 65.9 minutes
* γ to λ: 167.0 minutes
* γ to μ: 105.8 minutes
* δ to ε: 97.7 minutes
* δ to ζ: 36.1 minutes

* ε to ζ: 80.5 minutes
* ε to η: 74.7 minutes
* ε to θ: 58.6 minutes
* ε to ι: 107.6 minutes
* ε to κ: 17.2 minutes
* ε to λ: 112.2 minutes
* ε to μ: 53.2 minutes
* ζ to η: 63.0 minutes
* ζ to θ: 130.2 minutes
* ζ to ι: 180.3 minutes
* ζ to κ: 68.3 minutes
* ζ to λ: 36.4 minutes
* ζ to μ: 54.6 minutes
* η to θ: 95.3 minutes
* η to ι: 181.0 minutes
* η to κ: 57.7 minutes
* η to λ: 97.0 minutes
* η to μ: 91.8 minutes
* θ to ι: 108.9 minutes
* θ to κ: 63.3 minutes
* θ to λ: 165.2 minutes
* θ to μ: 111.8 minutes
* ι to κ: 124.7 minutes
* ι to λ: 203.5 minutes
* ι to μ: 131.1 minutes
* κ to λ: 102.2 minutes
* κ to μ: 53.8 minutes
* λ to μ: 72.4 minutes

The logistical objective is to identify the most temporally efficient circuit that executes each mandatory handoff precisely once before the courier returns to the initial hub of departure.
